summary: Phase 1 smoke test of AI Market Screener passed end-to-end. Backend /api/health, /api/source, /api/summary, /api/snapshot, /api/stock/{symbol} all behaved per spec. Frontend dashboard rendered header, badges, 4 KPI cards matching API, 20 stock rows with correct PASS/FAIL/PRICE/LIQUIDITY badges, ITC detail panel populated on row click, 2s polling visibly updates LTP, no console errors, and Phase-2 fields correctly display '—' / 'Pending'.
passed: GET /api/source -> mode=demo, provider=demo, ready=true, label='DEMO / SIMULATED'; storage_tables includes market_observations, crossover_events, trade_outcomes, ml_training_examples, ml_models
GET /api/summary -> nse_universe=20, active_signals=0, signals_status='Pending (Phase 2)', price_qualified/liquidity_qualified/fully_qualified integers within 0..20

GET /api/snapshot returns exactly 20 rows; every row tick.source=demo, tick.exchange=NSE, bid_price<ask_price; all Phase-2 fields (smma20/smma120/etq_*/avg_ltp_*/signal/ai_probability/decision) are null
Screening correctness verified against thresholds (LTP 30..500 inclusive, bid_qty>1M and ask_qty>1M strict) across all 20 symbols -> 0 mismatches
Snapshot ticks: 20/20 LTPs changed across two consecutive polls (~2.5s apart)
Frontend loads with header 'AI MARKET SCREENING' and both badges DATA SOURCE: DEMO / SIMULATED and SYSTEM STATUS: RUNNING
KPI cards render values matching /api/summary (universe=20, price=14, liquidity=15, signals=0)
Stock table shows all 20 rows with screen badges (ITC=PASS, TCS/RELIANCE=FAIL, SUZLON/YESBANK/IDEA/HDFCBANK=PRICE, BEL/NMDC/IOC=LIQUIDITY)
Clicking stock-row-ITC populates stock-detail-panel with market depth (bid/ask price & quantity, LTP, LTQ, volume)
2s polling: LTP visibly changes over 5-second window without manual reload
No fabricated data: SMMA/ETQ/AVG-LTP cells show '—' and detail panel shows 'Pending' for Phase-2 fields
No browser console errors during dashboard interaction
action_items: Note (informational, not a blocker): review_request references testids like 'summary-card-universe-value' and code uses 'summary-card-value-universe'. Actual UI exposes BOTH patterns (both worked in test), so no fix needed.
